environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in TCP passthrough mode. Instance runs Amazon Linux 2023 with Python 3.11, gunicorn workers. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request filtering or inspection layer. SQLite database stored on EBS volume at /data/app.db.

config.load_balancer: NLB in TCP passthrough mode (no L7 inspection)
